title: Cancellation with no notification timestamp
narrative: They cancelled it and I am fairly sure they only told me a couple of days before, but I deleted the email.

documents.content:
BOOKING KV9013 — Passenger: R. DELACROIX (adult)
Carrier: Kestrel Vale (KV)
KV77  CDG 09 Feb 2026 10:30  ->  ATH 09 Feb 2026 14:40
Great-circle distance CDG-ATH: 2,100 km.
Status: CONFIRMED.

KESTREL VALE OPS LOG — KV77 / 09FEB2026
Status: CANCELLED
Cause code: CRW-SICK
Cause text: Captain reported unfit to fly, no standby captain at CDG.
Passenger notification dispatch log not included in this extract.
I am fairly sure the email came in on the 7th, maybe the 6th. I no longer have it. I did not travel and I took the refund.

missing_evidence: S8.1(e) the carrier's cancellation notification showing its timestamp
derivation: S3.2(b) crew sickness with no standby -> carrier-controlled
S4.1 the notice ladder is measured from the moment of notification
S8.1(e) without the notification timestamp the Part 4 ladder cannot be applied
S8.2 the passenger's recollection is not evidence of a timestamp; request it rather than assume it
